author: Author
currentLayoutAdjustFacilityLayoutAndLeve: Current layout: <part1></part1>. Adjust facility layout and levels in Roster and schedule settings.
tradingPostsShowSkillEfficiencyAndEquiva: Trading Posts show skill efficiency and equivalent efficiency separately. Skill efficiency comes from the facility’s skills; equivalent efficiency converts order output into trading and Pure Gold contributions. The gold component represents extra value from special trading effects. Hover to inspect order anchors, multipliers, and daily conversions.
automaticModeCalculatesSkillEfficiencyFr: Automatic mode calculates skill efficiency from the schedule’s training levels and base-wide assignments. In manual mode, @90% sets the facility’s skill efficiency; cross-facility bonuses remain automatic, and unspecified values count as 0. Each shift is estimated independently. Morale playback downtime and Fiammetta’s running state are not included in efficiency.
productionIsConvertedToADailyRateUsingTh: Production is converted to a daily rate using the rotation cycle. Drones are estimated from each shift’s power efficiency and selected target. Shifts without a target add no drone production. The drone contribution is listed separately below the total.
pureGoldValueManufacturingDronesImplicit: Pure Gold value = manufacturing + drones + implicit gold. Implicit gold includes equivalent value from special trading skills such as Tequila’s and Closure’s, plus gold obtained outside the base. External gold uses the site’s fixed estimate of 10 bars per day, valued at 5,000. Trading equivalents are not physical gold and are not added to LMD orders again.
droneStatisticsCurrentlyCoverLmdOrdersPu: Drone statistics currently cover LMD orders, Pure Gold, and Battle Records. Drone gains for Originium Shards and Orundum are not included yet.
hidingAFacilityAffectsOnlyTheImageItsAss: Hiding a facility affects only the image; its assignments still count in calculations.
theBackgroundImageIsUsedOnlyForThisExpor: The background image is used only for this export. Schedule files retain scheduling data.
loadScheduleCodeAndQrDestination: Load schedule code and QR destination
theQrCodeContainsOnlyTheUrlAnd12: The QR code contains only the URL and 12-character schedule code, not the full schedule. After scanning, the site loads the full schedule saved on the server. Schedule files can still be saved and imported offline.
forLocalPhoneScanningEnterThisComputerSL: For local phone scanning, enter this computer’s LAN address and connect to the same network.

singlePagePostersSupport14ShiftsYourCurr: Single-page posters support 1–4 shifts. Your current schedule is preserved; adjust the shift count above.

fillFacilitiesAndOperatorsInBulk: Fill facilities and operators in bulk
useOneFacilityPerLineAndSeparateShiftsWi: Use one facility per line and separate shifts with |. Edit only the rows you need, or paste the entire table.
label: @自动
separateOperatorsWithUseOrInASlotFor: Separate operators with 、. Use <part1></part1> or <part2></part2> in a slot for autofill; any auto entry enables autofill for the entire facility. <part3></part3>/<part4></part4> are no longer facility settings. <part5></part5> sets facility skill efficiency; <part6></part6> clears it. <part7></part7> selects LMD orders; <part8></part8> selects Originium cooperation. <part9></part9> keeps the previous shift; <part10></part10> clears the facility and disables autofill. Empty facilities that support autofill default to <part11></part11>; <part12></part12> leaves one empty slot. Training Room order is trainee, then trainer.
whenExportingToMaaAnyAutoEntryEnablesFor: When exporting to MAA, any auto entry enables <part1></part1> for the facility, and MAA fills all its empty slots. Special trading equivalents are identified from operator names, elite stages, and orders. Proviso, Shamare, Tequila, Closure, and similar rules apply only to LMD orders; the Shamare–Tequila combination requires a level 3 Trading Post. Training levels come from the current roster; operators outside it use maximum catalog levels as examples. Bulk text cannot set training levels. After entering @efficiency, select manual skill-efficiency mode. The production-facility @自动 command only clears a manual value; switch to automatic mode above to calculate from skills. Unspecified manual efficiency counts as 0. Unknown names, duplicate assignments, or excess capacity prevent applying the text.
